Dear founder,

I am writing to apply for the Design Intern / Junior Designer role at your studio. Your focus on visual identity and marketing websites for tech companies immediately caught my attention.

My background is in digital marketing and web, but design has always been part of my work. I have designed and built websites from scratch, including my own site baverok.com with a hand-coded WebGL hero, and client sites in WordPress and Shopify. I create layouts, work with typography and color systems, and prepare design files for development. I am fluent in Figma for UI design and design systems, and I have a basic understanding of UX principles. I also have experience with Webflow and a strong interest in SaaS and tech companies.

I am eager to learn and grow in a small team, and I am excited about the opportunity to work closely with founders and contribute to real projects from idea to launch.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your studio.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear founder,

I am writing to express my interest in the Design Intern / Junior Designer position at your studio. Your focus on visual identity and marketing websites for tech companies resonates deeply with my background and aspirations.

My journey in digital marketing and web development has always been intertwined with design. I have designed and built websites from the ground up, including my own site baverok.com, where I hand-coded a WebGL hero and implemented structured data and accessible markup. For client projects like mirook.com, I created a multi-page website with JSON-LD schema and ran technical audits to improve search health. These experiences have taught me to balance aesthetics with functionality and performance.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage CMS content and on-page SEO for client websites, often collaborating with designers and developers. I have also worked on Shopify stores, handling store design and product catalogues. My technical skills include HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and I am proficient in Figma for UI design and design systems. I have a basic understanding of UX principles and am familiar with Webflow. I am particularly drawn to the SaaS and tech industry, where design plays a crucial role in communicating complex value propositions.

I thrive in small teams where I can learn directly from founders and see projects evolve from idea to launch. I am curious, detail-oriented, and motivated to improve continuously. The opportunity to work on branding, website design, and digital experiences for B2B SaaS companies excites me, and I am eager to contribute to real client work while growing my skills.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my blend of design and technical skills can add value to your studio.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
